initiatives.name: Bean Enterprise Management System
initiatives.overview: Building a multi-tenant enterprise management platform designed to centralize business operations, connecting inventory, sales, branch management, and internal ticketing through a unified system.
initiatives.contribution: Architected and developed the majority of the backend using Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, implementing authentication, email-verified registration, role-based permissions, PostgreSQL-backed sessions, and audit logging.
initiatives.highlight: Wrote most of the multi-tenant backend: authentication, role-based permissions, PostgreSQL-backed sessions, and audit logging.
initiatives.status: Developing the platform toward pilot deployment.
initiatives.statusNote: Pilot applications are not open yet.

initiatives.label: Retail POS & Business Operating System
initiatives.name: Clementine BOS
initiatives.overview: A mission-critical retail Business Operating System engineered for neighbourhood shops and micro-retailers. Built to power counter sales, barcode scanning, append-only stock ledgers, and cashier governance with high resilience on unreliable networks.
initiatives.contribution: Architected and engineered the Android cashier application in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose with on-device ML Kit barcode scanning and crash-safe cart persistence. Designed the Spring Boot REST backend with Flyway migrations, pessimistic row-level locking for zero-race-condition transactions, and idempotent sales handling.
initiatives.highlight: Native Android POS with on-device ML barcode scanning and an idempotent Spring Boot backend with append-only inventory ledgers.
initiatives.statusNote: Targeting production deployment and Google Play Store distribution.

capabilities.name: Hardware & scanning
items: On-device barcode scanning via CameraX & Google ML Kit
Modern native UI with Jetpack Compose & Material 3

capabilities.name: Inventory & governance
items: Pessimistic locking (FOR UPDATE) for concurrency safety

capabilities.name: Analytics & audits
items: Owner metrics dashboard via read-only database role
Full audit logging & stock override tracking

initiatives.label: Quantitative Trading / Software Engineering
initiatives.name: Tangerine
initiatives.overview: An actively developed quantitative cryptocurrency trading platform exploring market-data infrastructure, systematic research, model evaluation, risk governance, and controlled execution. It treats research, evaluation, risk controls, and execution as one auditable system rather than a generic trading bot.
initiatives.contribution: Designing and building the platform end to end: backend services, a persistence layer with versioned migrations, a model-evaluation workflow, and a frontend for research and monitoring.
initiatives.highlight: One auditable pipeline from market data through model evaluation to risk-governed, controlled execution.
initiatives.statusNote: Not a finished commercial product. The source code is private; a separate showcase site previews the interface and engineering scope.
